title: fieldPatches: make the fold, the install door and os validate agree on a patch of a field another extension adds, and fix the stale actions guidance list
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ③ the three should-fix findings of the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of PR #28728 (#28565), comment 6560336731, filed by the seat before ACCEPT rather than reworked into a reviewed head. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat: p3 (the key is new, no shipped package patches an extension-added field; the spec sentence stays true), under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).
Reach: a package author patching a field that another extension (or the same extension's `fields`) adds, and any author reading the `actions` refusal on an object extension.
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/field-patch-targets.ts`, `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`).

## What happens (read in the tree at f82fd682)

1. **Three readers, three answers for a patch of an extension-added field.** The registry fold applies it only when the adding extender has LOWER priority than the patching one (contributor loop order); the `reportFieldPatchMisses` docblock's "applies on the next read" is false for a higher-priority adder. The install door judges against the fully resolved registry object, so it admits the patch. `os validate` judges against declared `objects` only (`declaredObjects` in `cli/src/utils/field-patch-targets.ts`), so it refuses it. `registry.ts` and `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` say a patch "reaches a field a lower-priority extender added"; the spec `.describe()` says "the target object's own fields".
2. **Stale guidance.** `ObjectExtensionSchema.guidance.actions` still says the merge carries `fields`, `label`, `pluralLabel`, `description`, `validations` and `indexes` "only"; the code comment above it already lists `fieldPatches`.
3. **Array-spelled fields.** The fold's miss warning uses the metadata-core judge, which reads array-spelled `fields`, while `recordFieldOf` patches record-spelled fields only; an array-spelled body through `foldObjectExtendersOnto` is neither patched nor warned.

## Wanted

- One answer for item 1, the same at all three readers and in the docs: either a field patch reaches only the owner's own fields (fold skips extension-added fields, install door judges the owner's body, docs and docblocks say so), or it reaches extension-added fields regardless of priority (fold applies patches after all additive merges, `os validate` folds in-stack extensions before judging). The seat's lean: owner's own fields only, which is what the published spec sentence already says and keeps D10 "display of a vendor field" narrow.
- Item 2: add `fieldPatches` to that sentence (or drop the "only" list).
- Item 3: judge and patch the same spellings in the fold.
- `Clause-②` and `Metadata-protocol` lines decided by the choice in item 1.

Links back: #28565, PR #28728, review comment 6560336731.
